COLISEUM · MVP 0.2

Find your way around.

First-person: move with your left thumb on the joystick. Swipe anywhere on the scene with your right thumb to look around. Choose Fast to cover more ground. Desktop also supports WASD and Shift.

Overhead map: drag to pan and pinch to zoom. Tap a named place to jump there, or tap a walking surface and choose Explore here. The map is orthographic and north-up.

Use Places to jump between the field, stands, peristyle, grounds and tower terraces. Modeled stair connections link the east field and plaza, and exterior grounds with the upper rim.

About this model

The model uses published dimensions and estimated details. New exterior paths, aisle steps and stair locations are schematic. Tower floor heights are estimates. These are exploration previews; physical routes and 0.30 m accuracy remain unverified. Temporary LA28 installations and detailed interiors are outside this version.
